special_instructions.verbatim: (1) IP maintains the responsibility for clearing and remaining within the assigned area.

(2) In Sections I45ΧΧ and I46ΧΧ (IFR Navigations) an IFR Navigation and an instrument approach procedure to a strange airfield will be executed at least once for each SP, via ATS Routes or Approach to Approach.
maneuvers: Instrument approach procedure to a strange airfield

special_instructions.verbatim: (3) In addition, in Units I45XX and I46XX a mission may be flown to specific Italian airfields (such as Lecce, Sigonella etc) and Cyprus. Restrictions and Directives derived from BD 3-1/HATC apply in these missions (i.e. fuel minima, weather restrictions, fly over water rules etc). On these airports refueling may be omitted when not necessary, given that the fuel minima/restrictions are met.
(4) Prerequisites of I4701 (Night IFR Navigation) are I4501 and I3601 in night conditions. Training event of I4701 will be completed before I4603.
(5) In case an SP lands in a foreign airport, the corresponding performance code for landing becomes "2".

(6) SPs will fly at least one IFR navigation mission, with two External Fuel Tanks (EFTs), for better familiarization with A/C flying characteristics. This requirement can be filled also in VFR Navigation.

(7) Instrument mission table. DUAL / SOLO — INSTRUMENTS CATEGORY / SECTION / SORTIES / HOURS: BASIC INSTRUMENTS I41ΧΧ 2 2,6 | ADVANCED INSTRUMENTS I42ΧΧ 2 2,6 | ADVANCED INSTRUMENTS I43ΧΧ 2 2,6 | CHECK RIDE I4490 1 1,4 | IFR NAVIGATION I45ΧΧ 2 2,6 | IFR NAVIGATION I46ΧΧ 3 3,9 | NIGHT IFR NAVIGATION I4701 1 1,4 | FINAL CHECK RIDE I4890 1 1,3 | TOTAL 14 18,4

derived_values.total_sorties_solo: NOT PRINTED — inferred. The SOLO (SORTIES/HOURS) columns of the p.191 table are entirely empty on every row, and the TOTAL row prints only '14 18,4' under DUAL. Value 0 is inferred from the empty SOLO columns and cross-checked against the MIF (instrument_t6a: sorties_solo=0 in all 8 unit columns). No per-section *_sorties_solo keys are emitted, because none are printed either.

special_instructions.verbatim: 1. SP will be evaluated in representative maneuvers that have been taught and his/her performance must be at the levels determined in the MIF tables. SP will be evaluated at least at one (1) instrument descent and one (1) final approach.
1. Check ride will be performed in an IFR navigation flight with an Instrument Approach at a strange airport.

flags: sections keyed by resolved unit ranges from D:\FDMS\data\mif\t6a.json (instrument_t6a); the syllabus prints the generic form (I41ΧΧ, I42ΧΧ, I43ΧΧ, I45ΧΧ, I46ΧΧ) with Greek capital Chi (Χ) — kept verbatim in section_verbatim.

CONFLICT I41ΧΧ: page 193 prints 'SORTIES/HOURS TOTAL: 3 / 3.9 — SORTIES/HOURS DUAL: 3 / 3.9', while the Instrument mission table (p.191) and the MIF table give 2 sorties / 2,6 hours for I4101-02. Not reconciled — both recorded verbatim.
Source typo preserved-with-note: the exercise line prints 'maintan track' (for 'maintain track') in every section; verbatim keeps 'maintan', the name field uses the intended 'maintain'.
Source typo: I42ΧΧ (p.194) prints '- ILS or LOC final approach. (1' with an unclosed parenthesis; min_number read as 1.

Source glyph defect: 'Μιssed approach' in I42ΧΧ/I43ΧΧ is printed with Greek 'Μι' instead of Latin 'Mi' (I45ΧΧ/I46ΧΧ/I4701/I4890 print 'Missed Approach' correctly). Verbatim preserved; name normalized.
'Aileron Roll – Wingover (3) – (3)' split into two maneuver entries (one number per maneuver, as printed pairwise); both map to MIF s/n 11 'Confidence Maneuvers'.
'Course intercepts (Inbound and outbound) and maintan track' spans two MIF rows (s/n 12 Course Intercepts, s/n 13 Maintaining Course); mapped to s/n 12.
'Arc intercept – Maintain Arc' spans two MIF rows (s/n 14 Arc Intercept, s/n 15 Maintaining Arc); mapped to s/n 14.
'Holding – Instrument Approach Procedure' spans MIF s/n 17 (Holding) plus the approach rows; mapped to s/n 17.
'VOR or TACAN Holding – Descent' (I41ΧΧ) spans MIF s/n 17 (Holding) and s/n 18 (Instrument Descent/Penetration); mapped to s/n 17.

mif_sn null for 'ILS or LOC final approach' (alternative between MIF s/n 21 ILS Approach and s/n 22 Localizer Approach) and for 'GCA (PAR or ASR) final approach' (alternative between s/n 23 GCA ASR and s/n 24 GCA PAR).

I4490 maneuver entries come from the section's SPECIAL DIRECTIVES – AIDS §1, not from the exercise list (the I4490 exercise list carries no numbers); the same text is also recorded under special_instructions. 'Final approach' left unmapped (any of MIF s/n 20-26). per='sortie' because I4490 is a single-sortie section.
I4890 exercise list carries no numbers at all — maneuvers is an empty array.

PDF pages 192 (-184-), 198 (-190-) and 206 (-198-) have no extractable text (blank/back pages); page rendering unavailable in this environment (canvas native binding missing), so they could not be visually verified.
Not recorded as maneuvers (no execution count): 'A/C configuration may be with two (2) External Fuel Tanks (EFTs)' in I45ΧΧ/I46ΧΧ/I4701/I4890 — configuration, not a repetition minimum.

Not recorded as maneuvers (no execution count): Special Requirements SRI-1 — 'SP will practice on Spatial Disorientation maneuvers (SRI-1).' (I41ΧΧ, p.193 SPECIAL DIRECTIVES – AIDS §1) and SRI-2 — 'SP will practice time and magnetic compass turns (SRI-2).' (I42ΧΧ, p.194 SPECIAL DIRECTIVES – AIDS §1). Both correspond to the graded MIF row instrument_t6a s/n 34 'Special Requirements' (= '1' in exactly I4101-02 and I4201-02, null elsewhere), but carry no printed repetition count — the '-1'/'-2' are identifiers, not counts.
No I3101 section exists in this document (search returned 0 hits); the Instrument category starts at I41ΧΧ. I3201 and I3601 appear only as prerequisites (simulator units, outside this category).

All numbers are section totals as printed (per='section'), except the single-sortie I4490 entries; no sums or derivations were computed, with one documented exception: special_instructions[6].numbers.total_sorties_solo = 0, which is inferred from the empty SOLO columns of the p.191 table (see that entry's 'derived_values' key).

scope='category' marks only the seven instructions of 'e. INSTRUMENT CATEGORY SPECIAL INSTRUCTIONS' (p.191). The last two entries come from the SPECIAL DIRECTIVES – AIDS of individual sections and carry scope='section' plus a 'section' key: p.199 §1 → I4490, p.205 §1 → I4890. Consumers filtering on scope=='category' must not apply them category-wide.
